== iOS simulators

- Fixed manual sessions on iOS 27 simulators ending with a DC-500 error about one minute after the device language was changed. The viewer now shows that the device screen is briefly unavailable, then the session recovers and testing continues in the new language. Recovery can take up to two minutes.
